source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Seven island polygons clustered from the ADM0 land-cover parts; simplified derived boundary committed with CC BY 4.0 attribution.
source_datasets.notes: Single ADM0 MultiPolygon of 86 land parts; clustered to Rarotonga, Aitutaki, Mangaia, Atiu, Mauke, Mitiaro, and Penrhyn by proximity to known island coordinates, with uninhabited Manuae/Takutea parts dropped as decoys. Missing the five northern atolls, which come from OSM.

indicators.label: Census population total
indicators.description: Island all-ages resident population from the wave's religion table.
indicators.method: Printed island Total in Table 2.4 (2011) or Table 2.04 (2016, 2021).
indicators.quality_notes: Resident population, all ages, in every wave; island denominators are comparable across the three island waves.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the island population reporting a named religion.
indicators.method: 100 * (sum of named religion categories) / island population.
indicators.quality_notes: Jehovah's Witness is folded into Other Religion in the 2011 and 2016 island tables and printed separately in 2021; folded back into affiliation, the named spine is comparable across waves. Percentages use each island's printed census population Total. Religious affiliation is the sum of the named religion categories; no religion is the published no-religion line (2011: the No Religion column only, with the separate Objected/Not Stated column retained in the denominator; 2016 and 2021: the combined No Religion/Not Stated line, which includes not-stated). The two shares therefore need not sum to 100 percent, and the no-religion basis differs across waves by construction; this is disclosed per row.

indicators.label: No religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share in the census no-religion line.
indicators.method: 100 * (no-religion line) / island population. 2011 carries the No Religion column only; 2016 and 2021 carry the combined No Religion/Not Stated line.
indicators.quality_notes: The no-religion basis differs across waves: 2011 is pure no-religion (national 841); 2016 and 2021 combine no-religion with not-stated (national 1,097 and 2,338). Disclosed per row. Percentages use each island's printed census population Total. Religious affiliation is the sum of the named religion categories; no religion is the published no-religion line (2011: the No Religion column only, with the separate Objected/Not Stated column retained in the denominator; 2016 and 2021: the combined No Religion/Not Stated line, which includes not-stated). The two shares therefore need not sum to 100 percent, and the no-religion basis differs across waves by construction; this is disclosed per row.

visual_layers.label: Religious affiliation %
visual_layers.description: Cook Islands census-affiliation share by island.
visual_layers.notes: Census affiliation, not practice, attendance, or membership. Comparable across 2011-2016-2021 at the named-affiliation level.

visual_layers.notes: The no-religion basis differs across waves (2011 no-religion only; 2016/2021 combine no-religion with not-stated).
